note: What a client sends while a match loads, saying how far it has got.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Who is reporting. Observed as every bit set, which names nobody.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, as a fraction.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How long the client expects still to take, in seconds.

bits.name: count
bits.note: How many reports have been made.

bits.name: ping
bits.note: Round trip time the client measures, in milliseconds.

bits.name: ready
bits.note: Set once the client is ready. Nothing observed has set it, so what a server does differently when it is set is unrecorded.

fields.name: unknown
fields.note: The lowest bit rises with the report that first reaches the end of loading. The bits beside it carry values a client never wrote for the message.
